paragraphs: Rav Tahlifa bar Avdimi. Rav Hisda sat considering a question; Rav Tahlifa bar Avdimi said to him: Bekhorot 37, end of side b. Some say, bar Avimi. He said in Shmuel's name: Pesahim 100, end of side a. He acted in accordance with Shmuel. Rav said, “This Torah scholar's first ruling is to the detriment”: Beitzah 16, end of side b.
